behavior._comment: Same image + command locally and in CI. A missing runtime degrades to native execution, recorded, never blocking.

sonarqube._comment: Generated active per ci-pipeline-generation.md Section 4.1.1 (sonar-project.properties + the CI scan/quality-gate steps are written active, guarded by the runtime skip-if-no-sources check). Flips to false only if the user answers 'skip' at the Section 4.1.2 setup gate — see runtime-artifacts/audit.md.

playwright._comment: Set true, with startCommand/readinessUrl resolved and testCommand adjusted if needed, the first time a work unit's manifest fragment (implementation/code-generation.md Step 11d) runs the Playwright UI Automation Gate for real. Story 1.2 (Upgrade to Premium UI Flow) is expected to trigger this.

toolInstallCommands.oxlint: npm ci  # oxlint is already a pinned devDependency in src/frontend/package.json
toolInstallCommands.eslint: npm i -D eslint@9.19.0  # used only for the complexity rule (D6) — oxlint has no configurable complexity threshold

ci._gatesComment: 'playwright' is appended here at generation time only once playwright.enabled is true — never present for a project with no UI at all. This project HAS a UI (src/frontend), so it will be appended the first time Story 1.2 runs the Playwright UI Automation Gate.
ci._rootsComment: D2_types is N/A for src/frontend — plain JSX, no tsconfig/tsc enforcement in this repo (only @types/react for editor support). D2 still applies to src/backend (mypy, added at bootstrap if not already present).
ci._comment: CI SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. The generated pipeline AND every local step read THIS block — neither one re-authors or independently re-derives any of these facts, root included.
